title: MTX_SNG_4_Dyre
episode: #The Super New Girl 4: Reign of Dyre

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you want to see a Super New Girl, Part 5?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right then... Now or never, peeps!
$SUPERZOE hesitates...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh...
Before she can make up her mind, Howard grabs Colt by the wrist and stops him from slicing through the door lock!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! What's the matter with you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's the matter with me? You're on a team now, Colt. We need to work together `as` a team.
nodes.text_bbcode: What's the matter with me? You're on a team now, Colt. We need to work together [color=#e23b3b][i]as[/i][/color] a team.

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE projects a force field in front of Howard, letting Colt slice through the door lock! Howard bangs on the force field!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, what are you...?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Howard, but this time, Colt is right. We don't have time to think!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: And we don't have to `defeat` Dyre, either... All we have to do is to stall him long enough for Professor Doom and the rest of our friends to get here.
nodes.text_bbcode: And we don't have to [color=#3b78e2][i]defeat[/i][/color] Dyre, either... All we have to do is to stall him long enough for Professor Doom and the rest of our friends to get here.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, $SUPERZOE... I trust you. Let's do this!
$SUPERZOE projects a force field in front of Colt, stopping his claws before they can slice through the door lock. Howard tackles Colt aside!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! What's the matter with you two?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's the matter with us? You're on a team now, Colt. We need to work together `as` a team.
nodes.text_bbcode: What's the matter with us? You're on a team now, Colt. We need to work together [color=#e23b3b][i]as[/i][/color] a team.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine... So what's the big plan?
Howard turns back to $SUPERZOE, Sam, Hector, and Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I guess, I was hoping that we could talk about it together. So any ideas?
One minute later...
Howard kneels down, using a blast of heat vision to carve a detailed floorplan of the auditorium into the sidewalk.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, so Hector, you think we should shrink down to rodent size and squeeze in through the air conditioning vents?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And Sam, you think we should hit Viktor von Dyre hard from both sides?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And Amanda you think we should... Wear color-coordinated outfits...?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah! And they should be `pinkle!` It's a color I made up. Pink mixed with purple. And they should also have `ribbows`, which are ribbons mixed with...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! And they should be [color=#3b78e2][i]pinkle![/i][/color] It's a color I made up. Pink mixed with purple. And they should also have [color=#3b78e2][i]ribbows[/i][/color], which are ribbons mixed with...

nodes.text: Overhead, the loud speaker crackles, and the feminine computer voice speaks again...

nodes.speaker: Loudspeaker
nodes.text: Attention, Spartans, please take your seats! The STANDARDIZED T.E.S.T. will begin in approximately `4 minutes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Attention, Spartans, please take your seats! The STANDARDIZED T.E.S.T. will begin in approximately [i]4 minutes![/i]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, for crying out loud! Time is wasting, and you're all talking about `zipquins!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, for crying out loud! Time is wasting, and you're all talking about [color=#e23b3b][i]zipquins![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Squee! I love those!
Colt shoves $SUPERZOE and Howard aside, leaps forward, and jams his claws through the lock on the auditorium door.
Meanwhile, inside the locked re-education classroom...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Pretty tight in here. I always figured that the Spartan Academy boys took their classes in elephant-sized rooms made out of platinomium...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But this place is barely big enough for a mouse!
Hector quickly transforms into an elephant, then a cute mouse, and then back to human form!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cut it out, Hector. It's not funny...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Didn't you see what happened to $SUPERZOE? This is for real!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, Howard, I was just trying to lighten the mood... We're all really upset about what happened.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah. $SUPERZOE was nice and looked pretty... When she wasn't see-through...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can almost not see her face right now...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just... I keep thinking... I was so mean to $SUPERZOE when she first showed up. Why wasn't I nicer to her from the start?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You can't beat yourself up like that, Sammy. There wasn't anything you could do.
Sam turns on Colt, sparking into flame!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nothing I could do? You're one to talk! You always skip out when things get hard!
Colt reflexively pops his claws!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not true! I only left you at the party because... Because...
Colt looks down, unable to continue.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Seriously? We're trapped in here, staring down the end of everything we ever knew, and you `still` can't tell me why you left me at the party!
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously? We're trapped in here, staring down the end of everything we ever knew, and you [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] can't tell me why you left me at the party!

nodes.text: Colt lowers his claws, and he looks away, ashamed...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're right. I should've told you...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But it doesn't matter now. No matter what we do in here, we're still stuck inside this stupid classroom!
Colt roars! He turns and jams his clawed fist into the electrified force field that lines the walls of the classroom!
There is a sudden spark... And an alarm sounds! Water showers down from the ceiling.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, what did you do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Wasn't me!
Colt steps back from the wall. The force field sputters and then winks out.
$SUPERZOE slips into the music room. Still invisible, she bangs on some drums and jangles the ivory keys of a Thessalian Tharpsichord...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: OooOOOoooOOO!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Heh... This racket should get Chad's attention for sure!
On cue, Chad steps inside, looking nervous. $SUPERZOE strums the strings of a zeetar!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Who... Who's doing that?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: OooOOOoooOOO!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: A ghost, huh? Well, I guess a ghost won't mind if I do this!
Chad slams the door shut and locks it tight. He then waves his hand, dispensing a shower of sand that blankets the entire room... And also $SUPERZOE!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Heh... Not so see-through, when you've got sand all over you!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Phht... I got sand in my mouth! `...Gross!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Phht... I got sand in my mouth! [color=#3b78e2][i]...Gross![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: And the sand is `you!` `...Double gross!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the sand is [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color] [color=#3b78e2][i]...Double gross![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Chad charges ahead! He shoulder tackles $SUPERZOE through a stack of instruments!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: `OWWW...` That hurt!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]OWWW...[/i][/color] That hurt!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah? Wait till you try this!
Chad chuckles and transforms his hand into a large sandy hammer!
At the last second, $SUPERZOE rolls to the side. The sandy hammer crunches down deep into the floor and becomes stuck.
$SUPERZOE scrambles over to the wall. A fire alarm is near her.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey! What are you doing? Don't pull that!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: This? I wasn't planning to... But since you're so worried about it...
$SUPERZOE looks to Chad and puts her hand on the handle...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Okay, here goes nothing...
$SUPERZOE steps over to the fire alarm. She looks to Chad as she puts her hand on the handle...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But whatever you do... Stall Viktor von Dyre. You can't let him turn on that machine!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Okay!
There is a final blast of static, and Denni's voice fades away. $SUPERZOE turns toward the building where Chad took Howard, Sam, and the rest...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Hang on, guys! I'm coming!
A few minutes later...
$SUPERZOE moves invisibly through the gilded hallways of Spartan Academy. She peeks around a corner and spies Chad standing guard by a doorway. Chad mutters to himself.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Stupid Dyre... Just like all the other teachers... Always telling me what to do...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Chad has to be guarding the re-education room where my team is being held.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'll have to get rid of him somehow...
Looking around, $SUPERZOE spies a fire alarm on the wall. She also notices that the classroom opposite her is filled with musical equipment.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Hmm. The fire alarm is loud, but maybe too loud. Maybe I should stay invisible and 'haunt' the music room...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't get cocky, $SUPERZOE. You may have gone toe-to-toe with Viktor von Dyre, but you barely escaped...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't think for a second you'll be so lucky the next time.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What I mean is... You need to think smart and be careful, $SUPERZOE. Okay? Don't take any unnecessary risks...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know you will, $SUPERZOE. You might be the New Girl here, but look at what you've done!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I mean, you stood up to Viktor von Dyre all by yourself!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I don't know about that...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I do, and I know you'll do great. Just remember to be smart and careful. Don't take any unnecessary risks...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Okay, what do we do?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll contact Professor Doom and assemble the rest of the students at Centerscore. We'll come to your aid as soon as we possibly can.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Meanwhile, you need to rescue the rest of your team and stall Viktor von Dyre!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Okay, Denni...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: It's a long story, actually...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: We came to Spartan Academy just like Professor Doom instructed us, snuck in, and then we found a Spartan Academy student named Chad tampering with the special ancient technology that keeps the island afloat. Then after that...
$SUPERZOE continues to explain their adventure, describing the fight with Chad in detail and the arrival of Viktor von Dyre.
She finishes with a stirring account of Dyre's plan to activated his STANDARDIZED Total Emotion Subjugation Technology...
There is another loud burst of brain static!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, what are you thinking? This is long-range mental telepathy! Everything after the word 'ancient' got cut off...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You need to keep your answers short and simple!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh, I guess I should've known that...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now, is the team in trouble? Stomp your hoof once for 'yes', and twice for 'no'...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Stomp my hoof? I'm not a horse...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No... Horses are succinct. Which is why I'm asking one.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're on the polo field right now, and the horse in the stables next to you saw everything.
A short while later...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks, Clyde! You've been a big help!

nodes.speaker: Clyde
nodes.text: `WHINNY!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]WHINNY!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, $SUPERZOE, now that I'm up to speed, we need to make a plan...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: It's bad, Denni! Viktor von Dyre is here, and the rest of my team has been taken prisoner!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Plus, Dyre is working on a device that can re-educate everyone at once!
Denni asks a few more questions, and $SUPERZOE answers her succinctly.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay, I think I got it... And thanks for keeping it short. SMS can't handle really long explanations...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I figured as much.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, now that I'm up to speed, we need to make a plan.
Dyre floats toward $SUPERZOE, hovering over her. His body casts a shadow over her face, and the brilliance of the sun puts him in ominous silhouette.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Still with us? You've shown much spirit, child... Much dedication...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Perhaps there is a place for you by my side after all... When you recover...
Dyre opens his palm one last time. A new energy ball forms, crackling ferociously... He places his hand directly over $SUPERZOE's face, and then...
All goes white!

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE flexes a mental muscle. Looking down, she can see her own hands fade away...
Becoming `invisible!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Becoming [b]invisible![/b]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yes! I did it!
The light of the explosion fades, and $SUPERZOE now stands in a scorched crater. Seeing her, Vikton von Dyre frowns.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Interesting... Willful `and` also powerful...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You must be. Nothing else can explain how one so young and so inexperienced was able to withstand one of my blasts...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: With time and proper re-education, you could be a mighty superhero.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: But time is something in short supply.
Dyre opens his palm, revealing another energy ball. He gestures toward $SUPERZOE again, and the ball of light zips toward her and detonates!
$SUPERZOE throws up a shield, but it's too weak to endure a second blast!
$SUPERZOE flies back, driven into the dirt. She can barely raise her head...
At the last second, $SUPERZOE uses her super power to raise a force field!
The energy ball hits hard! Even with the force field up, $SUPERZOE staggers back. There is an explosion, a blinding flash of light!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Nhh... That was close. I can't take another hit like that. My only chance is to... Disappear...
$SUPERZOE hesitates... The blast strikes her with full force!
$SUPERZOE flies back, driven into the dirt. She can barely raise her head...
$SUPERZOE reaches back, grabs Beth by the ears, and pinches down!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh! That really hurts!
$SUPERZOE tries to pull the tail away from her throat, but Beth has too much leverage!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I tried... But I just couldn't...
$SUPERZOE leans forward, pulling down even harder on Beth's ears!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh! That hurts even more!
$SUPERZOE wrenches Beth by the ears and flips her over her shoulder! Beth meows as her head hits the floor at a bad angle, and then she passes out, gently snoring...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: A little cat nap... It'd almost be cute...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: If she hadn't been trying to do the same thing to me just a few seconds ago.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: `OOOF!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]OOOF!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Professor Doom recoils and fires back! The blast sends Viktor von Dyre crashing backwards into the Standardized T.E.S.T device. There's an explosion!
Von Dyre's eyes roll back in his head... He twitches... And he drops to his knees!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Must always b-b-buh... Behave...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa... What happened to him?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I think he's been re-educated.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: May I have... Anothuurrr boook...?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, he doesn't `sound` too educated, re- or otherwise.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, he doesn't [color=#e23b3b][i]sound[/i][/color] too educated, re- or otherwise.

nodes.text: Professor Doom nods somberly.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: The device was damaged... And now so is Viktor's mind. It's fitting that the last brain he tampered with was his own.
Professor Doom snaps his fingers, and a coloring book and a box of crayons appear in mid-air.
The set floats over to Viktor von Dyre. He begins coloring, obediently staying between the lines.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Now that Viktor has been defeated, we can begin the work of helping all the students he has harmed.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Truly, this was a dark day... But there is a brightness, too.
Professor Doom floats over to $SUPERZOE and rests a hand on her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: That a girl, new to this school could contribute so much, so soon... It is something worth celebrating! ...Do we all agree?
There is a shout of approval from far back in the crowd! Then another! Soon, the whole of the gathered crowd is whooping and cheering!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go $SUPERZOE!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! That's my cuz!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Eh, she did all right...
Sam elbows Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! From me that's a compliment!
Professor Doom turns to Headmistress Whitfield and winks.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Well then, I suppose I have no choice. Tonight, we shall celebrate with a dance!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: The students of Monarch Prep and Wilson High are of course invited, as are the students of Spartan Academy...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Provided they are not serving detention.
Professor Doom points toward a nearby vent... A sandy puddle of water levitates upward! It reforms into Chad!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `GAHHH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]GAHHH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Well then... I think that's everything! Let us away!
Professor Doom turns and takes to the sky, towing Viktor von Dyre and Chad behind him.
Then Headmistress Whitfield, the Monarch Prep girls, and the Wilson High students fly away after!
Last but not least, the Centerscore students take to the air! Howard turns to $SUPERZOE, extending a hand...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, coming...?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You bet!
Howard pulls $SUPERZOE tight, and together, they rocket skyward, the warmth of his body acting as a talisman against the cool rush of evening air.
In formation, $SUPERZOE, her new friends, and her new boyfriend fly back toward her new school...
And as they pass across the sinking, orange-red sun, Howard leans forward and gives $SUPERZOE a tender kiss.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Hee!
You have reached the end of `The Super New Girl 4: Reign of Dyre!` We hope you enjoyed it!
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]The Super New Girl 4: Reign of Dyre![/b] We hope you enjoyed it!

nodes.text: And as a special treat... Here's a Bonus Scene!
Later that night, at the celebration...
$SUPERZOE and Howard talk with Hector and Amanda by the snack table.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yeah, it was so much fun! Afterwards, I told Howard that we should go out in public as our `secret identities` all the time! It was like we had this big secret and nobody but us knew!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, it was so much fun! Afterwards, I told Howard that we should go out in public as our [color=#3b78e2][i]secret identities[/i][/color] all the time! It was like we had this big secret and nobody but us knew!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sounds like you two had fun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yup! Nobody gave mild-manned Conroy Kindlebrittle or sweet-but-sassy Vickie Valentino a second glance!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Not even when mild-mannered Conroy gave that jerky French maitre d' a heat vision hotfoot!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Classic, dogg... `Classic!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Classic, dogg... [color=#e23b3b][i]Classic![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Nearby, Amanda looks down at the ground.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aww, babe... What's the matter? Are you not having fun?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No! I'm having a great time! But then $SUPERZOE mentioned having a secret, and I remembered that I have a secret too! A big one!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, what is it?
Amanda cocks her head slightly. Her hair rises, almost as if it were ablaze, and her skin radiates a pulsating red light. She speaks with a voice not her own.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `I can't tell you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I can't tell you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh...
Amanda coughs, and she suddenly goes back to normal...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I mean, I can't tell you, because if I did... It wouldn't be a secret anymore!
By the stage...
Zach and Jacob quiz the formerly brainwashed students about their experiences.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: So you guys were really brainwashed, and you don't remember anything about the fight?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: My jaw sure remembers... That Howard kid hits hard!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: And Hawk Gunner has dried cat spittle all over his awesome threads...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Using my mystic powers, I could unlock the memories that our re-integration procedure locked away inside our heads.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Really? You can do that?

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: I think so. Let me try... `Cognito lux!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think so. Let me try... [color=#3b78e2][i]Cognito lux![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Raven waves her hands, and the group goes suddenly silent. Cheeks turn beet red.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Uh... Guys? Why did you all stop talking?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Oh no... I remember what we did...

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: Hawk Gunner is soooooo embarrassed now...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What happened? What did Viktor von Dyre make you do?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Viktor von Dyre made us try on a bunch of different superhero outfits to see which ones were the best...

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: And the locker room was co-ed!
On the dance floor...
Dex does jerky, complicated, robotic dance moves while Keith, Denni, and several other students watch.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Whee! Look at me go! Now this is how you do the Robot!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You can't do the Robot if you `are` a robot... Then it's just called dancing!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can't do the Robot if you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] a robot... Then it's just called dancing!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, I saw you doing the Rubber Band earlier! How is that any different?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Because I've got style!
Keith extends his arms out ten feet and then snaps them back! The force causes him to spin around super-fast!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooh, I bet a guy that flexible could do some super French kissing!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No kidding!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No way! That's not more stylin' than me!
Dex leaps out next to Keith, spinning on gyroscopes! They fall into a cool, coordinated dance routine! The rest of the crowd fills in around them, dancing and clapping!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whoo!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look at them go!
Outside, by the gym...
Sam and Colt sit together on a bench, talking. Out here, the muffled sounds of dance music seem remote and far away.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Sam, I never told you what happened that night, because the truth is... I didn't remember...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't remember leaving me at the party or crashing Tom Prince's space limo into the sun?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, I do... I remembered that, and I remembered that I had a good reason for what I did.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I just didn't know what it was...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow. Did you practice being not convincing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Would you just let me finish, Sam? I'm telling you, I had a good reason to go! The best! And I remember what it was now!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I left to rescue my `sister.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I left to rescue my [color=#e23b3b][i]sister.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You have a sister?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There are still pieces from my memory missing, things I can't recall, but...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I think so... And I think she's in a lot of trouble...
Sam puts her arm around Colt, and he rests his head gently against her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's okay, Colt, I believe you. And we'll figure it out... Together.
And far away, in a cold prison cell...
A lonely, tired, shell of a would-be world conqueror sits by himself in the dark, muttering.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: They think they've defeated me by locking me away in this prison?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Ha! This is no more than a set back!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: My time will come. Viktor von Dyre, Dreadlord of Doomsday, shall rise once again, and when he does, he shall...
Viktor von Dyre freezes mid-sentence, his eyes roll back in his head, and his voice softens to a whisper...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: He shall b-b-buh... `Behave.`
nodes.text_bbcode: He shall b-b-buh... [color=#e23b3b][i]Behave.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: And that's the Bonus Scene!
Thanks again for playing `The Super New Girl!`

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE cries out...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Professor Doom... `Look out!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Professor Doom... [color=#3b78e2][i]Look out![/i][/color]

nodes.text: But it's too late!
As Professor Doom turns back toward $SUPERZOE, Viktor von Dyre's energy ball strikes him square in the chest!
$SUPERZOE uses a force field to lift a sheep grazing in a nearby field!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Wh... Why did I do that?
Meanwhile, Viktor von Dyre's energy ball strikes Professor Doom square in the chest!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Hey! I don't see any Harbinger of Galactic... `UGHHH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! I don't see any Harbinger of Galactic... [color=#e23b3b][i]UGHHH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Rainbow colored sparks shoot out like fireworks, and a massive bolt of energy strikes Viktor von Dyre square in the forehead!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: What...? `NOOOO!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What...? [color=#e23b3b][i]NOOOO!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE raises a force field in front of Professor Doom!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: What? I don't see any Harbinger of Galactic... Huh?
The energy ball strikes the force field head-on, ricochets back at the Standardized T.E.S.T. equipment, and causes a second short circuit!
$SUPERZOE lifts up a folding chair from the floor to block the energy ball!
But the energy ball's too powerful! It sears a hole straight through the metal and strikes Professor Doom square in the chest!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: What? I don't see any Harbinger of Galactic... `UGHHH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What? I don't see any Harbinger of Galactic... [color=#e23b3b][i]UGHHH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE hesitates...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh, Professor Doom...? Umm...
As Professor Doom turns back toward $SUPERZOE, Viktor von Dyre's energy ball strikes him square in the chest!
There is a yelp and Raven falls next to Beth, also unconscious. An instant later, the two are joined by the slumbering form of Adam... Then Spike, Hawk, and Paula!
Colt and Howard stand behind the pile of bodies, triumphant. Just behind them are Sam, Hector, and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good work, guys. Now that we've polished off the appetizers...
Howard glowers at Viktor von Dyre.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's time for the main course!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yummy! ...Punching makes me hungry!
On stage, Dyre looks up from his equipment with a maniacal gleam in his eye! The feminine computer voice speaks...

nodes.speaker: Loudspeaker
nodes.text: Attention, Spartans, please take your seats! The STANDARDIZED T.E.S.T. will begin in approximately `10 seconds... 9... 8...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Attention, Spartans, please take your seats! The STANDARDIZED T.E.S.T. will begin in approximately [i]10 seconds... 9... 8...[/i]

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Hear that? You children are too late to stop me! `...Too late!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hear that? You children are too late to stop me! [color=#e23b3b][i]...Too late![/i][/color]

nodes.text: `BBRBBADOOOM!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]BBRBBADOOOM!!![/b]

nodes.text: There is a great rumbling sound, and the foundations of the auditorium jerk abruptly from side to side. Rafters crack and shriek. Ceiling tiles drop from overhead...
And then the entire roof rips away like the lid pulled off a peanut butter jar!
For a moment, the sunlight beaming down is overpowering, casting the entire room in an unpunctuated white...
And then, as eyes adjust, $SUPERZOE can see a man descending from the heavens.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Prof... Professor Doom...?
Flanking Professor Doom are other teachers, and the entire assembled student bodies of Centerscore High, Wilson High, and Monarch Prep.
Professor Doom nods to $SUPERZOE, smiling warmly.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: You and your friends have done well, my child. Better than I ever could've asked.
Professor Doom tilts his head to the side, abusing Viktor von Dyre with a chilly glare!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: And as for you, Viktor. You've been a very naughty boy.

nodes.speaker: Loudspeaker
nodes.text: The STANDARDIZED T.E.S.T. will begin in approximately `3... 2... 1...`
nodes.text_bbcode: The STANDARDIZED T.E.S.T. will begin in approximately [i]3... 2... 1...[/i]

nodes.text: Professor Doom waves a hand toward the device, and its internals sizzle! There are pops! Crackles! The device sputters one last time... `And breaks!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Professor Doom waves a hand toward the device, and its internals sizzle! There are pops! Crackles! The device sputters one last time... [b]And breaks![/b]

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: No, please... You don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: These naughty children were trespassing, and I was just... I was just, um...?
Dyre jerks his finger up, pointing skyward!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: My god! Is that Cruxis, Harbinger of Galactic Annihilation?

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Hrm...?
Everybody but $SUPERZOE and Viktor von Dyre turns to look up. Von Dyre opens his palm to reveal an energy ball crackling with power. He flings it toward the Professor!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: No, Professor!
$SUPERZOE leaps forward, concentrates, and...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: That's good. We wouldn't want physical ailment to impair our mission...
$SUPERZOE, Colt, and Howard rise to their feet and salute Dyre, who now floats triumphantly above the Spartan Academy stage!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Our mission... To serve Viktor von Dyre!
$SUPERZOE hesitates...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh...
$SUPERZOE hesitates...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh...
And then before she can recover, Beth pulls her tail even tighter!
$SUPERZOE hesitates...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh...
And then before she can recover, Beth pulls her tail even tighter!
Howard cracks his knuckles and flies toward Adam. They swap evenly-matched punches, and then Howard secures a right hook across Adam's jaw!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]ERK!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yes... Go Howard!
There is the sound of shifting rubble directly behind $SUPERZOE, and then Beth leaps forward again! She wraps her long, furry tail around $SUPERZOE's neck like a garrote!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]HKK!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Now then, kitten... What were we doing before we were so rudely interrupted?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh, that's right... You were about to take a cat nap!
Beth pulls her tail tighter, restricting $SUPERZOE's air flow. $SUPERZOE feels her strength sapping away, and her eyelids begin to flutter closed...
$SUPERZOE concentrates, placing two tiny force fields over Adam's hands!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: See! It's just like what I did with Prissy in the Monarch Prep rescue. Now that Adam can't touch objects, he can't charge them with kinetic energy.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: And you did say you're just as strong as him...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So it's a level playing field! I'm happy to take `those` odds!
nodes.text_bbcode: So it's a level playing field! I'm happy to take [color=#e23b3b][i]those[/i][/color] odds!

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE concentrates, putting a force field around Howard!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Okay, see! Now that you have a force field around you, Adam can't hit you anymore!
Howard presses his fingertips against the force field and frowns...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Howard, what did you say? I can't hear you through the force field?
Howard takes a deep breath and yells. Even so, the sounds reaching $SUPERZOE through the force field sounds distant and faint...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I said, 'Adam can't hit me, but I can't hit him either'...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh, I guess I didn't think about that...
$SUPERZOE lowers the force field just as Adam lobs another football over! It detonates, knocking $SUPERZOE and Howard to the ground...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: `Nnnhhh...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Nnnhhh...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That does it... Hitting `me` is one thing, but hitting my `girlfriend...?`
nodes.text_bbcode: That does it... Hitting [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] is one thing, but hitting my [color=#e23b3b][i]girlfriend...?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE hesitates...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I... I need to do something!
Then, deep in Colt's mind, he `remembers...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Then, deep in Colt's mind, he [b]remembers...[/b]

nodes.text: Colt crawls free from a scorched escape pod. Over head, the sun still burns brightly, flaring up as the quantum core of Tom Prince's space limo adds fuel to the corona!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Got to... Not much time... Must...
Colt, his face and hands scarred by radiation burns, drops like dead weight to the snow-blanketed earth.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Uhfff...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Uhfff...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: He looks up and sees a quaint, familiar cottage, nestled within a grove of conifers. Coils of smoke rise up from the chimney, signaling the warm hearth waiting within.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Almost there... Just need to...
Colt rises, his flesh knitting together, bones mending... He stumbles toward the cottage, barely registering the high-pitched whine of an incoming `rocket`, and then suddenly...
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt rises, his flesh knitting together, bones mending... He stumbles toward the cottage, barely registering the high-pitched whine of an incoming [b]rocket[/b], and then suddenly...

nodes.text: `The house explodes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]The house explodes![/b]

nodes.text: Colt is cast backward, flipping head over heels. He rolls to a stop by the tire tread of a jeep.
Standing over him is a man in a green military officer's uniform. The face of the man is still blurred out, a blindspot in the sight of memory. The man in uniform speaks...

nodes.speaker: General
nodes.text: Crashing a limo into the sun. Very desperate, Colt. We `made you` to be better than that, smarter than that... And now we find you `here`, trying to go `home?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Crashing a limo into the sun. Very desperate, Colt. We [i]made you[/i] to be better than that, smarter than that... And now we find you [i]here[/i], trying to go [i]home?[/i]

nodes.speaker: General
nodes.text: Don't you know? What they say is true... Try as you might, you can never go home again.
Colt grimaces, baring sharp fangs...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You won't... Get away with this...

nodes.speaker: General
nodes.text: Of course I will. You don't have the first clue who I am...

nodes.speaker: General
nodes.text: And as scrambled as your brain already is, just wait until we loan your special services to Viktor von Dyre. I hear his re-education process is almost as mind-bending as the one we put you through...
The man in uniform glances back toward the smoldering remains of the cottage...

nodes.speaker: General
nodes.text: Hmph... And don't worry about your sister. This home may be gone, but we're giving her a new one. Someplace cozy...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My sister...? `My sister...?`
nodes.text_bbcode: My sister...? [color=#e23b3b][i]My sister...?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `RRRRAAAAAAHH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]RRRRAAAAAAHH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt leaps up from where he knelt, and he shoulders Raven in the stomach. His claws shred into the fabric of her ink-black cloak.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: `AHHH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Colt, are you...?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Free and clear, See-Through. I can handle Nightmare Lady from here.
Colt and Raven continue fighting, trading agile martial arts blows! Meanwhile, $SUPERZOE feels teeth dig into her forearm!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]OWW!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Don't forget about me! We're not done yet!
Beth crouches down on top of $SUPERZOE! She raises her clawed fingers high to deliver a mighty swipe!
Time seems to slow down...
To $SUPERZOE's right, Colt tussles with Raven. Overhead, Adam and Howard trade massive super-powered punches in mid-air...
And on-stage, Viktor von Dyre types feverishly into the console of his device. A feminine computer voice delivers another address.

nodes.speaker: Loudspeaker
nodes.text: Attention, Spartans, please take your seats! The STANDARDIZED T.E.S.T. will begin in approximately `2 minutes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Attention, Spartans, please take your seats! The STANDARDIZED T.E.S.T. will begin in approximately [i]2 minutes![/i]

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Yes... Yes... Any second now!
Beth starts to swing and...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE! ...NOOOO!!!
Howard shoots a blast of heat vision that sends Beth crashing through an entire row of chairs!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: `Kfff!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Kfff!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: His attention diverted, he doesn't see Adam wind up a massive uppercut!
A punch like a thunderclap hits Howard square across the jaw!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Uhhff!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Uhhff!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard is knocked back and down, digging a trench in the auditorium floor. He comes to a groaning stop at $SUPERZOE's feet!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh no, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... $SUPERZOE... Look out!
Directly above, Adam cocks a football, readying to throw. Energy radiates up from his fingers, charging the leather...
He unleashes the ball, and it flies toward $SUPERZOE and Howard in a perfect spiral!
Howard leaps to his feet, putting himself directly between the ball and $SUPERZOE. It strikes him in the shoulders, detonating like a claymore!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `NHHH...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]NHHH...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Howard, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Adam is as strong as I am... Plus he can also charge inanimate objects... With kinetic energy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't know if I can stop him.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Sure you can, Howard. I can project a force field outward, remember? I can put one around...
$SUPERZOE uses Beth's paw to scratch Colt across the cheek! Locked in his trance, Colt barely even flinches...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Must get home to... Get home to...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh no... That didn't work...
Then the flesh of Colt's cheek begins to knit together, sealing the wound!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh... That's kind of... Itchy...
$SUPERZOE uses Beth's tail to tickle Colt's nose! Though locked in his trance, a slight smile crosses his lips...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I think it's working...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh... Hee! Stop! I'm ticklish... I...
$SUPERZOE hesitates...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I... I need to do something!
Beth follows after, and she and $SUPERZOE flail around on the floor!
Nearby, Colt kneels near Raven. His pupils are rolled back in his head, exposing the whites of his eyes!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: {{ That's it... You've failed everyone you ever cared about! {{

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: {{ And now you'll have to relive those terrible memories again and again... {{

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Must steal... Space limo... To get home to...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh no! Raven is doing something to Colt, messing with his memories somehow...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm near enough to Colt, I might be able to snap him out of it!
In one hand, $SUPERZOE grabs Beth's right paw, and in the other, she grabs Beth's tail!
$SUPERZOE lashes out, using what she holds to...
$SUPERZOE leaps up, and the claws rake across her chest!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: `Ahh...` Not cool. I really liked this shirt!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahh...[/i][/color] Not cool. I really liked this shirt!

nodes.text: When she lands, Beth's tail is waiting! It wraps around $SUPERZOE's ankle, pulls taut, and sends $SUPERZOE sprawling backward to the floor!
$SUPERZOE ducks the swipe! From her low vantage, she can see Beth's tail raking up from below!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Sneaky... But not sneaky enough!
$SUPERZOE stamps on Beth's tail and grinds her heel down!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: `HISS!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]HISS!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Beth yowls and jerks backward. She rubs her wounded tail, and then charges forward. $SUPERZOE is knocked back...
$SUPERZOE raises a force field that stops the swipe! But she doesn't see Beth's tail raking up from below and snaking around her ankle!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What the...?
Beth yanks her tail up... And $SUPERZOE sprawls backwards!
$SUPERZOE hesitates, and the claws rake across her chest!
She also doesn't see Beth's tail raking up from below and snaking around her ankle!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What the...?
Beth yanks her tail up... And $SUPERZOE sprawls backwards!
Dyre motions toward a platform on the far side of the stage. From below, three silhouetted figures rise up!
The first holds up a football. A glow passes up through his fingertips and imbues the ball with a powerful explosive charge!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]HN...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The second figure emerges from a cloud of black smoke! She waves a gloved hand, and swirls of mystic energy knit themselves around her head and hands!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: `...Necro Morstrum Kaliya!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...Necro Morstrum Kaliya![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The third figure cocks her head with a feline tilt, and then rakes her hands through the air in a fierce, clawing gesture!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: `MEEOWWW! HISS!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]MEEOWWW! HISS![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh no... The one on the left is `Adam.` He's one of the strongest footbrawl players ever to graduate from Centerscore High...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no... The one on the left is [color=#e23b3b][i]Adam.[/i][/color] He's one of the strongest footbrawl players ever to graduate from Centerscore High...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Plus Raven got a 2400 on her Spellcasting Aptitude Test, and Beth is... Well, pretty hot!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just saying... They're the best!
Colt bench-presses a slab of rubble off of himself and rises to his feet. His claws gleam brightly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wrong again, Squaresville... I'm the best!
With a mighty roar, Colt leaps at Raven and tackles her! They tumble off the stage!
At the same instant, Howard takes to the air and charges Adam. Adam throws a football. Howard dodges in the nick of time!
The football hits the back wall and detonates like a grenade!
Beth leaps down from the stage and saunters slyly up to $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I guess that just leaves you and me, New Girl. Do you really think you can handle my `purr`fect fighting technique?
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess that just leaves you and me, New Girl. Do you really think you can handle my [color=#3b78e2][i]purr[/i][/color]fect fighting technique?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Just try me!
Beth claws high, her razor-sharp nails swinging toward $SUPERZOE's face!
Invisible or not, $SUPERZOE is still there... And the eye blasts strike her chest with the force of a hammer!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: `OOFFF!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]OOFFF![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Viktor von Dyre smirks.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Hmph... Pathetic... With abilities like yours, it almost seems like a waste to pit you against my star pupils!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: `...Almost!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...Almost![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The eye blast ricochets off $SUPERZOE's force field and strikes the stage at von Dyre's feet! Splinters fly up, stinging him!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Take that!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: `NNHH...` Imagine that. You miserable students are actually managing to upset me.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]NNHH...[/i][/color] Imagine that. You miserable students are actually managing to upset me.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Which means... It's time for you to face my star pupils!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh...
$SUPERZOE hesitates... And the eye blasts strike her chest with the force of a hammer!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: `OOFFF!`
Viktor von Dyre smirks.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Hmph... Pathetic... With abilities like yours, it almost seems like a waste to pit you against my star pupils!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: `...Almost!`
Sam's body erupts into flame, and the vines choking her burn away to cinders! Paula recoils as if slapped!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: `AHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right then!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, here's the deal. Hector, Amanda, and I can take these three! You, Howard, and Colt make a run at von Dyre!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Works for me... `RRRROWWRR!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Works for me... [color=#e23b3b][i]RRRROWWRR!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Hector transforms into a mountain lion, jumps up, and grabs Hawk in his jaws! They crash through the wall of the auditorium!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: HAAWWWKKAAA!!!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Tiara Thief...` Let's take this outside!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Tiara Thief...[/i][/color] Let's take this outside!

nodes.text: Sam seizes Paula by the wrist and flies them both out the ragged, newly-made exit hole!
Amanda reaches out and grabs Spike by the collar. He chars her with flame, but the heat doesn't even sizzle her eyebrows.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector... Hector, wait for me!
As Amanda swings Spike outside like a rag doll, $SUPERZOE, Howard, and Colt turn their attention back toward Viktor von Dyre!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now then... Where were we? Oh, that's right... Time to slice and dice!
Colt leaps onto the stage and swipes at Viktor von Dyre! Without looking up from his calibrations, von Dyre grabs Colt firmly by the ear!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh oh...
With a quick flick of the wrist, he sends Colt crashing past Howard into the rear wall!
Howard shoots eye blasts at von Dyre, who deflects them with an energy shield and sends them screaming right toward $SUPERZOE!
$SUPERZOE activates her power and...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.text: So you escaped, and you liberated your friends? I suppose I should've figured as much when the fire alarm went off.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Fortunately for you all, I don't have time to deal with you personally. My lackeys, to me!
A door near the stage bursts open! Three impressive figures step out.
The first does a wild kick flip on a silver skateboard, shaking a flare-asol spray can! He sprays a terrifying fireball!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Shake and bake!
The second makes a lifting gesture, and thick, living vines crack up from the earth to entwine her arms!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Pretty like a flower... But watch out for my thorns!
The third punches the air dramatically and then screeches like a bird of prey!

nodes.speaker: Hawk
nodes.text: HAAWWWKKAAA!!!

Spike pulls a zero-G kickflip on his floating skateboard and sprays another blast of flame! Paula commands a clutch of seething, barbed vines like an orchestra conductor! Hawk Gunner transforms into a gigantic bird of prey equipped with a powerful blaster ray!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Spike, Paula, Hawk... What's the matter with you guys?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: It's not their fault, Hector. They've been re-educated!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: The same thing happened to Colt, and it'll happen to `all of us` too if we don't stop Viktor von Dyre!
nodes.text_bbcode: The same thing happened to Colt, and it'll happen to [color=#3b78e2][i]all of us[/i][/color] too if we don't stop Viktor von Dyre!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: We just need to...
And then before she can recover, Beth pulls her tail even tighter!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Good... Very good...

nodes.speaker: Loudspeaker
nodes.text: Attention, Spartans, please take your seats! The STANDARDIZED T.E.S.T. will now begin!
A white bubble of light radiates upward from the device, fills the whole auditorium, and then explodes outward!
The pulse travels through every classroom at Spartan Academy and then expands outward across the sea toward the three other schools.
In an instant, Centerscore High, Wilson High, and Monarch Prep are all enveloped!
The light fades, and though the world seems no different... The super-powered students have all been irrevocably altered...
Back in the auditorium, $SUPERZOE stirs and wakes up. She looks over to Howard and Colt.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Howard, Colt, are you all right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My injuries are trivial.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As are mine.

nodes.text: `To serve Viktor von Dyre!`

nodes.text: `VIKTOR VON DYRE!`

nodes.text: Outside, more voices join in on the chant! Sam, Hector, and Amanda cry out! 'Viktor! Viktor! Viktor!'...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre

nodes.text: Yes, uh... Yes, sir... Right away, sir.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Are you going to re-educate them now, sir?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: My mom says I really need to get better grades if I'm going to get into super college.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Not even close...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Now then, kitten... What were we doing before we were so rudely interrupted?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh, that's right... You were about to take a cat nap!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Must always b-b-buh... Behave...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa... What happened to him?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I think he's been re-educated.

nodes.text: May I have... Anothuurrr boook...?

nodes.text: Professor Doom nods somberly.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: The device was damaged... And now so is Viktor's mind. It's fitting that the last brain he tampered with was his own.

nodes.text: Now that Viktor has been defeated, we can begin the work of helping all the students he has harmed.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Truly, this was a dark day... But there is a brightness, too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go $SUPERZOE!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! That's my cuz!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Eh, she did all right...

nodes.speaker: Colt

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Well then, I suppose I have no choice. Tonight, we shall celebrate with a dance!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: The students of Monarch Prep and Wilson High are of course invited, as are the students of Spartan Academy...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom

nodes.text: Last time on `The Super New Girl...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Last time on [b]The Super New Girl...[/b]

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, Howard, and a few other students were dispatched to Spartan Academy to stop Viktor von Dyre from sinking the school!
They defeated Chad, saving Spartan, but were no match for von Dyre himself!
And now let's travel back in time to the moments leading up to Dyre's attack on $SUPERZOE!
And now...
Viktor von Dyre, the Dreadlord of Doomsday levitates high in the air above the polo grounds of Spartan Academy...
Behind him, Chad kneels, sniveling.
$SUPERZOE casts an eye towards her friends... Howard, Colt, Sam, Hector, and Amanda are all imprisoned inside a glowing ball of light!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Guys, are you...?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Don't worry, moppet. Your friends are fine. They'll be `re-educated`, turned into responsible members of society...
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry, moppet. Your friends are fine. They'll be [color=#e23b3b][i]re-educated[/i][/color], turned into responsible members of society...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: But you... You are willful. Stubborn. I'm not sure you `can` be rehabilitated.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you... You are willful. Stubborn. I'm not sure you [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] be rehabilitated.

nodes.text: Von Dyre raises his hand, and an energy ball forms in his palm. The energy ball hums with terrible power.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I believe that children are our future...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: But you? ...Not so much.
Von Dyre gestures toward $SUPERZOE, and the energy ball rockets out of his palm and speeds straight towards her!
Professor Doom rises, standing next to them.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: It's good you are well, my students. We wouldn't want physical ailment to impair our mission...
Professor Doom salutes Dyre, who now floats triumphantly above the Spartan Academy stage!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Our mission... To serve Viktor von Dyre!
What's this? $SUPERZOE, Howard, Professor Doom and the rest are forever in thrall to Viktor von Dyre, Dreadlord of Doomsday?
Can no one save them? Not even Clyde?

nodes.text: Professor Doom drops from the sky like an arrow-struck dragon and crashes down to the destroyed floor of the auditorium. His head lolls to the side, eyes vacant, staring at $SUPERZOE with crushing disappointment.
Viktor von Dyre leaps to his feet. He taps a button on a backup system and a computer voice delivers a final address!
